carbon_credit_balance_on_chain.description: Cache of CarbonCredit (ERC-20) balances on the OGCR chain (chain id 2025). One record per holding address, covering both operator wallets and the ERC-6551 token-bound accounts of credit batches. Populated by OGCR-chain-cache, which derives the holder set from Transfer events and then reads each balance at the current head. Balances are current-state, not historical: each record is only true as of block_number.

owner_address.description: Address holding the balance, lowercase-insensitive checksum form. The business key for this record. Match against operator.ogcr_wallet_address or land_manager.ogcr_wallet_address to find a party's holdings.

balance.description: CarbonCredit balance in smallest units, as read at block_number. Decimal string because a uint256 does not fit an integer field. Divide by 10^decimals for tonnes CO2e.

decimals.description: Decimals of the CarbonCredit ERC-20, for rendering balance.

holder_type.description: Whether this address is a plain wallet or the ERC-6551 token-bound account of a credit batch. One of: wallet, token_bound_account. A token_bound_account balance is credits still held inside their batch; a wallet balance is credits withdrawn from a batch and now pooled.

batch_token_id.description: When holder_type is token_bound_account, the CarbonCreditBatchNFT token id this account belongs to. 0 otherwise. Join to `carbon_credit_batch_on_chain`.token_id.

contract_address.description: CarbonCredit ERC-20 contract address the balance was read from.

block_number.description: Block height the balance was read at.
